headline: Brighton 3-0 Arsenal: champions lose their first league game
whyCareReason: The champions were beaten 3-0 at the Amex on Saturday. Sunday closed Matchweek 5. City now lead on 15 from five. Arsenal have 12. Brighton have 10.
teaser: FINAL: Brighton 3-0 Arsenal. Brighton.com: Groß 31', Kostoulas 45', Chema Andrés 57'. Arsenal 12 from five after Sunday.
story:
Why this one matters: Arsenal arrived 4-0-0. Brighton are the league's top scorers. The Amex finished 3-0, and the champions have a first league defeat.

Brighton.com: Pascal Groß 31', Charalampos Kostoulas 45', Chema Andrés 57'. Sky, The Athletic, The Guardian and ESPN print the same 3-0.

Sunday closed the week: City 5-3 Sunderland. ESPN UK table: City 15 from five, Arsenal 12, Brighton 10.
stakes: Matchweek 5 is closed. The champions have dropped points. City lead on 15.
rivalryAngle: A south-coast side that already beat Arsenal 3-0 in May 2023 did it again, this time at the Amex.
